profile.headline: Software @ AWS | ex-MSFT
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a passion for web technologies, with a focus on full stack development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Manage and attend to tickets and bug fixes over 50 applications that are used by thousands of people and students that were primarily built on Rails 2 and 3.
● Planned and carry out the revamping of existing applications using C#, with a focus on building small, easily maintainable, and extensible microservices.
● Worked closely with researchers to build a shared decision making bank that are used by the surgeons in the school.

company.name: UW School of Medicine and Public Health

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
● Implemented a cloud-based solution that runs an executable on the cloud
(Heroku, AWS, IronWorker) to simulate structural deformations using the MVC
pattern.
● Integrated and linked the cloud application on different platforms using OAuth
2.0 as authentication for custom RESTful API calls.
● Improved project workflow by integrating webpack hot-build into the
application and using development, staging, and production environment.

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description:
● Developed and maintained the deployment and testing of multiple websites on
different platforms.
● Formulated and implemented full-stack solutions with integration to payment
systems such as CashNet.
● Reduced bot-filling spam by 100% by implementing server-side validation
using Captchas and the honeypot method.

company.name: WEMPEC (Wisconsin Electric Machines and Power Electronics Consortium)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Worked in an Agile Scrum process to create, test, and release an IP
configuration page that allows static and dynamic IP changes.
● Utilized NodeJS, HTTP requests and response to run scripts on the background.
● Developed and tested firmware and software patches through a USB upgrade
process that deals with the kernel.

positions.title: GIS/Web Technician
positions.description:
● Worked on web programming and various scripting languages to support various web-based                       applications.
● Documentation and maintenance of the content on the main SCO website.
● Languages used : Javascript, Java, PHP, PostgreSQL, HTML5, CSS.

projects.title: Open GeoPortal
projects.description:
-Edit, update, and manage metadata for the library’s GIS data repository
-Contribute to metadata editing guides, while addressing workflow shifts due to software version changes and metadata standards
-Presented at a geospatial summit on the progress and workflow changes of the Open GeoPortal project
